title: Optimized alamarBlue assay protocol for drug dose-response determination of 3D tumor spheroids
author: Eilenberger, Kratz, et al.

steps.title: Harvest and prepare HepG2 cells
steps.instruction: Use log‑phase HepG2 cultures at 60–80 % confluence (grown in 75 cm² flasks); pre‑warm all media to 37 °C. Remove medium, wash cells with PBS, add 5 mL trypsin solution and incubate ≥5 min at 37 °C until detachment. Add 5 mL fresh culture medium, transfer suspension to a 15 mL Falcon tube and centrifuge 5 min at 294 × g. Aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in 5 mL fresh medium, and pass the cell suspension through a needle with a syringe to obtain a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Adjust cell suspension density
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL cell suspension with 10 µL Trypan Blue, load 10 µL onto a cell‑counter slide, determine cell number and viability, and dilute or concentrate the suspension to obtain a final density between 5 000 and 25 000 cells · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Seed spheroids in anti‑fouling plates
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the 15 000 cells·mL⁻¹ suspension to each well of a U‑bottom 96‑well plate that has been coated with a self‑assembled anti‑fouling nanobiointerface (cell‑repellent microwell plate).

steps.title: Optional centrifugation for uniform spheroids
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the seeded plate for 10 min at 294 × g to promote formation of uniformly shaped spheroids (optional for HepG2).

steps.title: Incubate spheroids for six days
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a humidified incubator at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ and culture for 6 days without medium exchange (medium exchange shown to have no effect on spheroid viability).

steps.title: Prepare sorafenib working solutions
steps.instruction: Store sorafenib as 10 mM aliquots in DMSO at –20 °C. Immediately before use, dilute the stock in the appropriate cell‑culture medium to obtain the desired test concentrations (0–1000 µM). Include untreated control and fluorescence background controls (phenol‑red medium, alamarBlue‑containing medium).

steps.title: Treat spheroids with sorafenib
steps.instruction: After the 6‑day incubation, gently remove the culture medium from each well using a syringe (hold the needle opposite to the spheroid to avoid aspiration). Add 200 µL of the pre‑diluted sorafenib solutions to the corresponding wells (triplicate wells per concentration) and incubate for 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Remove drug solution post‑treatment
steps.instruction: Aspirate the sorafenib‑containing medium gently with a syringe to avoid physical damage to the spheroids.

steps.title: Prepare alamarBlue assay mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh complete culture medium and add alamarBlue® reagent to a final concentration of 10 % (v/v). Mix the solution by shaking.

steps.title: Add alamarBlue mixture to spheroids
steps.instruction: Dispense 200 µL of the alamarBlue‑containing medium into each well containing a spheroid.

steps.title: Incubate alamarBlue and read fluorescence
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 24 h at 37 °C protected from light. Measure fluorescence with a plate reader using excitation 560 nm and emission 590 nm.

steps.title: Calculate percent viability
steps.instruction: Compute viability as % viability = (Experimental RFU with compound ÷ Untreated control RFU) × 100.

steps.title: Prepare Live/Dead staining solution
steps.instruction: Mix 2 µL of 4 mM Calcein AM with 4 µL of 2 mM Ethidium homodimer‑1 and bring the volume to 1 mL with PBS.

steps.title: Stain spheroids and image live/dead
steps.instruction: After drug exposure, remove medium, wash spheroids with 200 µL PBS, and gently aspirate PBS with a syringe. Add 100 µL of the staining solution to each well, incubate 30 min at 37 °C protected from light, then image live cells (Calcein AM, ex 485 nm/em 530 nm) and dead cells (EthD‑1, ex 530 nm/em 645 nm) using a fluorescence microscope.
